records.label: A2000-01 · Feed and product basis
records.status: No basis approved — follows the A-1000 case
records.detail: D-A2000-01 withdraws the RO-2001 feed basis and approves only the design statement that A-2000 sizing follows the acid-recovery decision (REP-039) and the A-1000 discharge route: the process-water demand build-up gives 8–18 m³/h net permeate (REP-008) against 17–120 m³/h of A-1000 effluent by case (REP-038). PFD-2000 has no stream table. The model's T-2001 1,000 m³, T-2002 140 m³ and T-2003 95 m³ are screening allowances, and the three RO trains A / B / C with P-2002 A / B / C exist only in the model — LST-001 and PFD-2000 list one RO-2001 and one P-2002.
records.action: Decide the A-1000 case, then issue the first A-2000 stream table on DBM V2.0 with the recovery, permeate quality and concentrate route; reconcile the three-train configuration with LST-001 / PFD-2000.

records.label: A2000-02 · RO feed condition — oxidiser, scaling and the NaOH question
records.detail: D-A2000-02 approves REP-038 as the process constraint: RO feed must be oxidiser-free and within BaSO₄ / CaSO₄ scaling limits; lime-stage gypsum saturation (≈ 1,480 mg/L) governs recovery; no NaOH upstream, because Na₂SO₄ at 61 g/L makes RO unworkable — which ties this area to the A-1000 flowsheet decision. P-2002 is approved as a 12–16 bar high-pressure pump (MAT-002 service register) as a screening basis. The model provides carbon filtration CF-2001 for oxidant / organic reduction and antiscalant dosing T-2004 / P-2004 ahead of the trains.
records.action: Carry the oxidiser-free and scaling constraints into the A-1000 MoC (lime-first, no NaOH) and into the RO design basis; confirm the antiscalant and recovery against the gypsum limit once the feed is fixed.

records.label: A2000-03 · Pretreatment and backwash
records.detail: The model provides the register pretreatment train MMF-2001 / GF-2001 / CF-2001 (parallel-vessel allowances) and a dead-end UF-2001 with two backwash banks, plus the model-only UF filtrate / backwash buffer TK-UF2001 with pump P-UF2001, the backwash collection TK-BW2001 with lift pump P-BW2001 to A-1000 and the control station CP-2000. None of the model-only tags is on LST-001; no filtration duty is approved.
records.action: Size the pretreatment on the A-2000 stream table; register TK-UF2001, P-UF2001, TK-BW2001, P-BW2001 and CP-2000 or record them by decision; state the backwash return in the A-1000 balance.

records.label: A2000-04 · Cleaning-in-place and spent CIP
records.detail: The model provides the register CIP skid CIP-2001 with recirculation pump P-CIP2001, a segregated spent-CIP hold TK-CIP2001-W (5 m³ allowance) with transfer pump P-CIP2001-W, and the antiscalant day tank T-2004 / P-2004. The CIP chemistry, frequency and spent-liquor destination are not defined; the spent-CIP tank and the two CIP pumps (P-CIP2001, P-CIP2001-W) exist only as model geometry without semantic records.
records.action: Define the CIP chemistry and cycle with the membrane selection; assign the spent-CIP destination (A-1000 stage or off-site); register the model-only tags.

records.label: A2000-05 · Materials of construction
records.detail: D-A2000-MOC applies MAT-002 to fourteen items with the RO service row — TFC polyamide RO elements in FRP pressure vessels, with the matching tank, pump, filter-housing and CIP selections; MDL-001 (HDPE / XLPE tanks, 316L pumps and housings, PVDF UF modules) superseded. The single MAT-002 row covers the whole area, so the tank and pump wording is generic and will need item-level refinement at datasheet stage.
records.action: Refine MAT-002 per item (tanks, pumps, filter housings, UF modules) once the stream table exists; keep the TFC / FRP RO selection.
